evals.prompt: I built a three.js product viewer for a watch (glTF with metal and glass parts). It looks flat and plasticky with a black background. I want it to look like a premium e-commerce render. What should I change? Give me the code for the lighting/rendering setup.
evals.expected_output: Environment lighting (RoomEnvironment via PMREMGenerator or HDRI with HDRLoader + EquirectangularReflectionMapping as scene.environment), tone mapping (Neutral or ACES/AgX) with exposure, sRGB output, soft shadows (VSM or contact shadow / ShadowMaterial ground), glass via MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission/ior/thickness, metal with metalness 1 and roughness map, blurred background (backgroundBlurriness) or gradient, optional bloom on highlights and GTAO; AA via antialias:true. Uses r186 names (HDRLoader, outputColorSpace, no PCFSoftShadowMap).
assertions: Adds environment lighting: PMREMGenerator + RoomEnvironment or HDRI via HDRLoader with EquirectangularReflectionMapping set as scene.environment
Sets tone mapping (ACES/AgX/Neutral) with exposure and keeps outputColorSpace sRGB
Glass via MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission/ior/thickness; metal via metalness 1 + roughness, not opacity hacks
Replaces black background: blurred environment (backgroundBlurriness), gradient or studio color
Soft shadow or contact shadow on a ground catcher (ShadowMaterial / VSM / radius)
Anti-aliasing enabled (antialias: true or AA pass) and no deprecated names (RGBELoader, outputEncoding, PCFSoftShadowMap, GammaCorrectionShader)

evals.prompt: Add a cinematic post-processing stack to my three.js WebGLRenderer scene: bloom only on emissive neon signs, ambient occlusion, slight film grain and vignette, and depth of field focused on the character. Keep tone mapping correct.
evals.expected_output: EffectComposer with RenderPass, GTAOPass, UnrealBloomPass (selective via layers/emissive strategy with threshold near 1 or material trick), BokehPass, FilmPass, vignette via ShaderPass or VignetteShader, OutputPass last (tone mapping + sRGB), HalfFloatType render target, composer.setSize on resize and MSAA samples; correct ordering and no GammaCorrectionShader.

evals.prompt: My outdoor three.js scene (terrain 2km wide, trees, a house) has shadows that are blurry blobs near the camera and disappear far away, and the edges of everything shimmer when the camera moves. How do I get crisp stable shadows and clean edges?
evals.expected_output: Cascaded shadow maps (CSM from three/addons/csm/CSM.js or CSMShadowNode on WebGPU) with cascades/maxFar, tight shadow camera, normalBias, mapSize, shadow map type choice; for shimmering: anti-aliasing options (MSAA antialias:true, TAA/TRAA, SMAA/FXAA), texture anisotropy and mipmaps for terrain, specular aliasing mitigation; mentions the cost tradeoffs.
